name: get_issue_changelog
descriptor: Inspects historical audit trail of status changes and edits on ticket
description: Fetches chronological history of field modifications on issue.

name: start_step_function
descriptor: Starts asynchronous execution of AWS Step Functions state machine
description: Launches serverless workflow execution with initial input JSON.

name: stop_execution
descriptor: Terminates running workflow execution and marks status as ABORTED
description: Aborts state machine execution immediately.

name: get_execution_history
descriptor: Retrieves chronological event log of state transitions inside workflow
description: Fetches execution history showing state inputs, outputs, and errors.

name: pause_workflow
descriptor: Pauses workflow execution at current state awaiting manual approval token
description: Holds workflow state pending external confirmation callback.

name: resume_workflow
descriptor: Submits approval token and resumes execution of paused workflow
description: Provides approval task token to continue workflow progression.

name: describe_state_machine
descriptor: Fetches JSON definition and IAM execution role for workflow
description: Returns Amazon States Language (ASL) definition of workflow.

name: retry_execution_step
descriptor: Retries failed task step with exponential backoff configuration
description: Re-executes failed workflow step with backoff parameters.

name: create_activity_worker
descriptor: Registers polling activity task worker for long-running batch job
description: Registers external worker polling for Step Functions tasks.

name: list_running_executions
descriptor: Lists all state machine runs currently in RUNNING execution state
description: Enumerates active workflow instances across environments.

name: update_definition
descriptor: Updates state machine JSON workflow logic without changing workflow ARN
description: Deploys new workflow definition to existing state machine.

name: send_task_success
descriptor: Signals successful completion of external task with result payload
description: Reports success callback to Step Functions task token.

name: send_task_failure
descriptor: Signals task failure with error code to trigger workflow catch block
description: Reports failure callback to Step Functions task token.

name: set_workflow_timeout
descriptor: Sets maximum execution duration before state machine automatically times out
description: Configures execution timeout to prevent zombie background workflows.

name: simulate_workflow_run
descriptor: Performs dry-run simulation of state machine logic with mock inputs
description: Simulates state machine progression locally without cloud calls.

name: export_dag_mermaid
descriptor: Converts workflow definition into visual Mermaid directed acyclic graph
description: Generates Mermaid diagram code from workflow state transitions.

name: validate_asl_syntax
descriptor: Lints Amazon States Language JSON for invalid transitions and dead ends
description: Validates state machine syntax against ASL specification rules.

name: track_branching_decision
descriptor: Logs which conditional Choice rule was selected during workflow execution
description: Captures decision branch taken during choice state evaluation.

name: audit_execution_events
descriptor: Audits timestamps, inputs, and outputs across all workflow task states
description: Produces execution timeline audit report for compliance verification.

name: clean_stale_executions
descriptor: Archives execution history older than retention window to manage storage
description: Purges old completed workflow execution logs.

name: schedule_cron_workflow
descriptor: Attaches recurring cron trigger to launch workflow on scheduled frequency
description: Creates EventBridge cron schedule triggering state machine execution.

name: resolve_dns_record
descriptor: Performs DNS lookup for A, CNAME, or TXT records via Route 53
description: Resolves DNS hostnames and verifies propagation across nameservers.

name: create_route53_zone
descriptor: Creates public or private hosted zone in Amazon Route 53 DNS
description: Provisions DNS hosted zone for domain name routing.

name: allocate_vpc_cidr
descriptor: Creates Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) with IPv4 address CIDR block
description: Creates isolated network environment with private IP routing.

name: create_subnet
descriptor: Provisions public or private subnet in specific availability zone
description: Creates subnet slice within VPC for multi-AZ redundancy.

name: attach_internet_gateway
descriptor: Attaches internet gateway to VPC to enable inbound and outbound internet traffic
description: Connects VPC network to external internet routing gateway.

name: update_route_table
descriptor: Adds routing table destination rule pointing traffic to NAT gateway
description: Configures subnet routing rules for outbound traffic control.

name: authorize_security_group_ingress
descriptor: Opens firewall inbound port for specific protocol and IP CIDR range
description: Adds ingress security group rule (e.g. allow TCP port 443).

name: revoke_ingress_rule
descriptor: Closes firewall port to eliminate unauthorized external network access
description: Removes open ingress rule from security group.

name: associate_elastic_ip
descriptor: Binds static public IP address to virtual network interface or NAT gateway
description: Associates reserved public IP with compute instance.

name: describe_nat_gateways
descriptor: Checks operational status and IP allocation of VPC NAT Gateways
description: Audits status and network throughput across NAT gateways.

name: test_port_connectivity
descriptor: Tests TCP socket handshake connectivity to destination host and port
description: Performs network ping and TCP SYN check to verify reachability.

name: flush_dns_cache
descriptor: Flushes resolver cache to clear stale DNS records across VPC
description: Clears recursive DNS resolver cache for updated domain records.

name: enable_vpc_flow_logs
descriptor: Captures IP traffic flow logs showing accepted and rejected packet connections
description: Streams network packet flow logs to S3 or CloudWatch for auditing.

name: create_load_balancer_listener
descriptor: Configures HTTPS port 443 listener on Application Load Balancer with SSL cert
description: Attaches listener with SSL termination to load balancer.

name: register_target_group
descriptor: Registers compute instances into load balancer backend target group
description: Adds server instances to target pool for traffic distribution.

name: deregister_target
descriptor: Safely drains traffic and removes instance from load balancer target group
description: Deregisters instance with connection draining timeout.

name: purge_cdn_cache
descriptor: Invalidates cached edge assets across Amazon CloudFront global CDN distribution
description: Purges edge cache invalidation path to deploy fresh assets immediately.

name: check_ssl_handshake
descriptor: Inspects TLS protocol version, cipher suite, and certificate chain validity
description: Audits SSL handshake and verifies TLS 1.3 negotiation.

name: create_vpc_peering_connection
descriptor: Establishes direct private network routing between two separate VPC networks
description: Creates peering connection allowing private IP routing between VPCs.

name: traceroute_endpoint
descriptor: Traces network packet routing hops to identify latency spikes and packet loss
description: Performs ICMP/UDP traceroute to diagnose routing bottlenecks.
